steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Packaging nets are 2D templates that fold into 3D containers — understanding tabs, glue flaps and die-cuts is essential. | Key Fact: Sustainable packaging considers material choice, minimal waste, recyclability and environmental impact. | Key Fact: Print processes differ: offset litho for high-volume, digital for short runs and variable data, screen for speciality finishes. | Key Fact: Information graphics use visual design to communicate data clearly — charts, diagrams, maps and infographics.
